assets.alt_text: A beekeeper holding a worn standard hive tool, showing the broad scraping end and hooked levering end
assets.caption: Hive tool in real use. A worn field tool shows the working edges and leverage surfaces that should be inspected for damage, sharp burrs and contamination. This is one common design.
assets.credit: Photo by Ivan Radic, CC BY 2.0.

assets.alt_text: Portable optical honey refractometer with its prism cover open
assets.caption: Portable honey refractometer. The photograph identifies the equipment; calibration, prism cleaning, representative sampling, temperature control and reading technique remain essential.
assets.credit: Photo by R. Henrik Nilsson, CC BY 4.0.
